name: What is the difference between quartz and marble for a bathroom vanity top?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between quartz and marble for a bathroom vanity top?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quartz and natural stone like marble or granite are the most popular materials, and the right choice depends on your daily routine and tolerance for maintenance. Quartz is non-porous and engineered to resist cosmetics, cleansers, and standing water without requiring periodic sealing. Natural marble offers classic beauty and distinctive veining, but it is porous and prone to etching from acidic soaps or personal care products. If you prefer low maintenance in a busy family bath, quartz is often the practical pick, whereas marble or granite suits homeowners seeking natural stone characteristics who are willing to apply routine sealers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quartz is non-porous and resists stains with zero sealing required. Natural marble offers classic veining but is softer, porous, and requires regular sealing to avoid staining.
